lines.trans: I nearly forgot about you—where are you taking shelter right now?
Do not even ask—I got stuck sheltering right outside my neighbourhood and had given up all hope.
Log in to the Xingtian live app right away and we will patch your feed straight onto television.
Brilliant idea—just give me a moment to get ready!
I will have the team send the script to your phone—alright, over to you.
Chun Yuqiao, I am all set on my end.
All competing singers of Twelve Singers, listen closely: wherever you are right now, log in to the Xingtian live app and send back your video feed.
Be yourselves in front of the camera and help the people around you who need a hand.
Good evening, viewers—welcome to the grand finale night of Twelve Singers, on a night when this dreamlike metropolis has suddenly been plunged into a rainstorm.
Twelve Singers was meant to be a feast of music, yet tonight not even I know where this live broadcast will take us.
However fiercely the wind and rain rage through this dark night, what warms our hearts is always our shared past and future.

examples.trans: When it is time to jump into the pot, you still have to jump in!

走向.gloss: head toward, move in the direction of

meanings.en: head toward, move in the direction of

examples.text: 谁也不知道这场特殊直播正在走向何处。
examples.trans: Nobody knows where this extraordinary live broadcast is heading.

examples.text: 年轻的中国原创综艺正在一步步走向国际市场。
examples.trans: Young domestic original shows are steadily heading global.

examples.text: 我欣赏的生活态度，就是不管你身处在什么处境，你都要做最好的自己。
examples.trans: The life attitude I admire is striving to be your very best self, no matter what circumstances you are in.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Verb duǒ ('duck out of sight, avoid').

examples.text: 我看你当时一直躲我，还以为讨厌我。
examples.trans: Seeing you dodge me back then, I assumed you disliked me.

examples.text: 遇到棘手的问题要正面解决，不能光躲。
examples.trans: Face tough problems head-on instead of dodging them.

examples.text: 在那边，要不我带您过去？
examples.trans: Over there — how about I take you over?

examples.text: 请各位歌手在镜头前做最真实的你们自己。
examples.trans: Singers, simply be your truest selves in front of the camera.

examples.text: 户外直播车迅速转移镜头，对准积水严重的路口。
examples.trans: The broadcast van swung its lenses toward the flooded intersection.

examples.text: 整座繁华都市骤然陷入特大暴雨灾害之夜。
examples.trans: The bustling city was suddenly plunged into a night of storm crisis.

风雨.gloss: wind and rain, storm; trials and hardships

meanings.en: wind and rain, storm; trials and hardships
meanings.note: Noun fēngyǔ ('wind and rain; storms of life').

examples.text: 不管狂暴的风雨在这个黑夜里如何肆虐。
examples.trans: However fiercely wind and rain rage through this dark night.

examples.text: 一路走来历经风雨，团队之间的默契更加深厚。
examples.trans: Having weathered storms together, the team's bond grew deeper.

examples.text: 这是马上啊。
examples.trans: This is right away.

examples.text: 那个马上好。
examples.trans: That right away is good.

meanings.note: Literary adverb zhòurán ('all of a sudden').

examples.text: 晴朗的夜空骤然变脸，下起了倾盆大雨。
examples.trans: The clear night sky changed abruptly and unleashed pouring rain.

examples.text: 灯光骤然熄灭，追光灯一束打在舞台中央。
examples.trans: House lights went out abruptly and a single spotlight hit centre stage.

examples.text: 不管风雨在这个漫长的黑夜里如何肆虐。
examples.trans: No matter how wind and rain rage through this long dark night.

examples.text: 温暖的歌声像一盏灯，照亮了风雨交加的黑夜。
examples.trans: Warm singing shone like a lantern through the stormy dark night.
